title: Whirlpool of Love
paragraphs: It’s true—this might be the kind of matter we should discuss with Father. Since we share the common goal of spreading the word about Filolial-sama, I imagine it’ll come down to deciding exactly what steps we’ll take to make the purchase.
“It’ll be fine.”
“I think we should think it over a bit more, though.”
“So, is it just that you’d like to purchase a Hakuko-type warrior slave? Got it.”
“That’s right. I’d like to see them right away.”
“This way, please.”

And just like that, we were led to the tiger siblings’ place. It was a scene similar to what I’d seen during the loop when Big Sister from the first world had come through the dimensional rift. It was the sight of a tiger boy tending to a tiger girl whose entire body was wrapped in bandages. The brother looks young, but I suppose that means he hasn’t reached the required level yet.
“I believe these are the slaves you’re looking for. Yes.”
Panda silently approaches the cell to look inside.
“…What the hell? This isn’t a sideshow.”

The tiger guy says this to the panda, who’s watching from outside the cell. When it was my turn, I just walked right in and showed him the Yggdrasil potion; the tiger guy reluctantly checked it over and over before finally letting me give it to him. For some reason, the tiger girl seemed a bit more hesitant to run away. Something about being scared of a maddening mass of love approaching her or something like that.
“Well, I don’t know…”
The Panda muttered, looking deeply moved.
“What should we do?”
“Spear Hero, you know what to do, right?”
“Of course I do!”
Once we went inside, I signaled the monster merchant, and he unlocked the cell door.
“W-what are you planning to do?!”
When the Panda and I entered the cell, the Tiger Man came to greet us.
“Should I just say it’s time for the medicine?”

At the Panda’s words, I shook the Yggdrasil potion I’d been handed to show him. The Tiger Man furrowed his brow and approached us. Perhaps because the Panda is a Beastman, he seemed slightly less wary. Then the Panda took the bottle from me and let the Tiger Man sniff it. Though I feel like he wasn’t very suspicious when I did it either.
“It’s Yggdrasil medicine!”
After sniffing the bottle like a dog, Tiger Man answers honestly.
“Are you worried it might be poison? Feel free to check it as much as you want.”
Tiger Man stares intently at Panda.
“I can’t afford the medicine anymore… or is it the match?”
“Don’t you think the aid might have arrived?”
“Huh? No, that’s…”

He seems different from when he came to give me the medicine before—he’s hesitating in his response to Panda. Well, I suppose this guy’s got his own issues. After all, he’s even sharing a bed with Father. I guess they get along well.
“You’re really keeping me in suspense.”
“…What’s your goal?”
“That’s right. There aren’t really that many reasons for me to be here, are there?”
“I suppose so. So, does that mean you’re my next employer? I’ll pay you back for the medicine by fighting. Is that okay?”
“It’s helpful that you’re so easy to deal with, but that’s not all, you know.”
Torao tilts his head at Panda’s reply.
“I’ve got a few things I’d like you two siblings to do for me, but fighting isn’t the only option, you know.”
“I don’t really get it.”
“You’re such a rough-and-tumble guy. You don’t have to overthink it. Anyway, is it okay if we give Big Sister the medicine?”
“Yeah… but if you pull any funny business, I’ll kill you!”
Huh? Tiger Man stepped aside without a fight.
“Well then, Spear Hero, I’m counting on you. It’s gotta be you, right?”
“Of course.”

At that, the Tiger Man furrowed his brow as he turned his gaze toward me. But I have no idea what he’s thinking. I approached the Tiger Girl with the Yggdrasil medicine in hand. I’m pretty sure back then, too…
“Is there someone there?”

Lying there, coughing repeatedly and wrapped in bandages, was someone who, at first glance, looked nothing like the Tiger Girl. Of course, since she can’t see, her face is almost entirely covered in bandages.
“Hii… it’s like a blazing, fierce sun, yet a maddening whirlpool of love!?”
“Atla!? Hey, are you okay?!”

The tiger man runs over to the tiger girl, just as I’ve seen him do before. But as I’ve thought time and again, she’s a girl who can only be described as incredibly fragile. I can’t even begin to imagine that she’ll grow to the point where she’ll throw herself into the path of the Phoenix’s self-destruction to protect everyone. But… she is a truly valiant and admirable Tiger Girl. If she hadn’t protected us, not only would Father and Filo-tan have perished, but Filolial-sama and even I might have died as well.
“B-Big Brother… please get out of here quickly! Otherwise, the flames will… Ah!?”
“Atla’s scared!? Don’t get any closer!”
The tiger man said to me in a flustered tone. Hmm, this is a bit of a confusing turn of events. Well, I’m sure it’ll be fine if I give her some Yggdrasil medicine.
“I don’t know how to put this… Spear Hero, are you really someone I can trust with this?”
“Of course! Hey, Tiger Girl, I have no intention of harming you guys. So I’d appreciate it if you’d just listen to me.”
This line worked on the Tiger Girl before, after all. It’ll be fine.
“Big Brother, you mustn’t disobey him. It’ll be too late once something happens. Please, don’t do anything to upset him.”

I appreciate how quickly this is wrapping up, but why is this guy being so subservient? I haven’t done anything, and I don’t intend to do anything. I simply respect him as a person—as the benefactor of Father and Filolial-sama. I’m here precisely to repay that debt of gratitude.
“B-but!”
“Brother… I beg you. You absolutely must not show any hostility. Do not resist. Just let them do as they please.” It’s my lifelong wish…”
“Atla… ugh…”
Weakly, the Tiger Girl clutches her brother’s arm and pleads. Meanwhile, the Tiger Man glares at me as if to say he’ll kill me with his eyes alone, all while holding her hand.
“Hey… doesn’t the atmosphere feel a little off?”

The panda lets out a exasperated sigh at this point, but if you let it bother you, you’ve already lost. I moved closer to the tiger man, crouched down, and brought the medicine close to the tiger girl’s lips.
“Here, drink this. It’s medicine to save you.”
“Y-yes.”
“Atla…”
“I’ll be fine… Big brother, please be happy…”
“Kuuuuuuu…”
“I wonder why these two are acting like this is their final goodbye…”

The panda says that, but I made the Tiger Girl drink the Yggdrasil potion. I’m not feeding her poison or anything. If I were going to give her poison, it’d definitely be the Crimson Swine. The Tiger Girl swallows it down without a fuss.
“Phew… phew…!?”

The effect is dramatic, isn’t it? After all, Father from the first world found all sorts of items that not only boost the potion’s effectiveness but also support various recovery skills. My spear has those kinds of skills, and I’ve mastered them all. There’s no doubt the effect is stronger than it was back then.
“My body… feels so light…”
The Tiger Girl’s cough stopped completely, and her stamina has recovered to some extent.
“My skin…”
It seems her wounds are starting to heal quickly beneath the bandages.
“That’ll do for now.”

Since I managed to get her to take the medicine properly, I stand up and step back. The tiger man and the tiger girl are both discussing something, but it seems the tiger man is starting to realize she’s on the road to recovery. Of course, since I can sense Ki, I can tell that it’s starting to overflow from her entire body. She should be able to walk in a few days. That is, if she realizes it herself.
“Well then, there’ll be a lot going on from here on out, but you’d better do exactly as we say. From what I hear, you won’t need to take that medicine anymore.”
“How can I believe that?! But I’m grateful you saved Atla’s life.”
“That’s fine. We’ve told you we have our own reasons, haven’t we?”
“Yeah… My name is Fohl. I’ll work to pay for the medicine from now on, so please take care of me.”
“Is ‘Atla’ okay as a name for your little sister?”
“Yeah.”
By the way, according to Father from the first world, Torao was strangely hostile back then. In my case, I’m not quite that hostile. I wonder what accounts for this difference?

From what my love sensor picks up, I can tell it was probably just the fear that Big Sister might be taken away from him. After all, Tiger Girl was constantly making her moves on Father. I can understand that—it’s all in the name of love.

I’m not so tactless as to interfere with other people’s romantic affairs. However, I can’t really let them meet this time. If the opportunity arises, I wouldn’t mind lending a hand. And while they’re busy registering the tiger guys as slaves, I’ll ask the Panda:
“Aren’t you going to mention that you were helping them?”
“It’s a hassle to make people feel awkward by letting them know for no reason…”
It seems the Panda intends to keep quiet. He’s the type who finds human relationships a hassle. Is being clumsy just part of his nature? He’s a bit different from Father, though.
“Well, eventually I’ll tell him that my parents took care of me. I just haven’t decided when yet.”
Even as he said that, Panda was looking at Torao with a slightly amused expression.
“Is that the kind of person you like, and that’s why you dislike Father?”
I’m pretty sure this guy’s role was supposed to be a Siltvelt assassin sent to seduce Father, wasn’t it?
“What are you talking about?”
“It’s a romance with the child of your first love, isn’t it?”
“Sorry, but that’s not my thing. What do you take me for, anyway? Seriously, every single one of you…”

And just like that, we’d secured the Tiger siblings. The tricky part is that we can’t take them to Siltvelt Castle. Because of that, we’ve decided to have them stay at my parents’ house until Panda finishes treating them—though she seemed rather reluctant about it.

Meanwhile, Father headed to the address I gave him—that of an old woman living in a nearby village that appeared during the last wave in Melromarc—and managed to get her to take the Yggdrasil potion. After a few days, the effects kicked in. The brave and fearless old woman regained her vigor, and upon learning that Father was the Shield Hero striving to save the world, she apparently promised her cooperation.
“Aww, man!”
“Come onnnnnnnnnnnnnnn!”

It was quite a sight to see the old panda and the elderly woman training energetically at the panda’s family home before heading out on a hunting expedition to level up. At first, the moment they encountered each other, they immediately started exchanging blows.
“Hehehehe… I never imagined I’d meet an old comrade-in-arms at my age. You never know what life has in store, do you?”
“That’s my line! This time, I’ll surpass you with my own strength.”
“I won’t let you surpass me that easily! I’ll reach new heights and train those who protect the Hero!”
“Then let’s go!”
“‘Haaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa!’”

Well, they’re certainly going at it with gusto. It seems their fighting spirit is burning not on the battlefield, but in this battle between old friends. Father, who’s kept his distance from the Tiger Men, is watching the two of them train.
“Wow… they seem incredibly energetic. Even though they were so weak before… I’m afraid they might just collapse like a dead battery.”
“Unfortunately, they were full of energy right up until they were killed in battle.”
Father looked over at me with a “Huh?” expression.
“Apparently, they were revived afterward. What incredible HP.”
“Isn’t that just hovering between life and death?”
That may well be. Of course, I plan to improve this old woman’s abilities as well, in preparation for the future. I won’t let her die in battle like what happened with Takt.
“These old folks sure are full of energy… I mean, this has turned into a situation I’d rather avoid. I wish they’d both just keel over somewhere.”
“Even Lars-chan is saying that, too.”
“I’m thrilled! After all, this means I can get closer to my ‘original self’ from the first world, just as Lord Kitamura of that school said!”

Éclair seemed quite excited and was asking the old woman to teach her all sorts of things. Although she was evaluated as having slightly lacking natural talent, it seems she’s making up for it with her enthusiasm. Panda, who was forced to accompany her during her subsequent training, began to work even harder, saying that the only time she felt at ease was when she was on guard duty for Father. In the end, I suppose it turned out to be a positive experience in many ways, didn’t it?

That’s the kind of slightly idyllic life we’ve been living lately. Seasonally speaking, things are starting to pick up on places like Cal Mira Island. However, I asked Father to increase the number of Filolial-sama, but he politely turned me down. Apparently, right now is the time to focus on maintaining Yuki-chan and the others’ popularity rather than bringing in new faces.
I suppose he has a point. If there are too many Idol Filolial-sama, I imagine it might be hard to remember all their faces. Still, I can’t shake the feeling that it’s a bit of a waste.
That’s how my day off went, filled with that kind of restless anticipation.
“Well, what should I do today?”

Apparently, Father has an inspection tour in Siltvelt today with Panda and Sakura-chan or something like that. This day off feels like something both Father and I agreed on—it’s a scheduled day of rest. It’s Father’s consideration, I suppose—even a hero would collapse if they worked day and night without a break. By the way, Father from the first world also let me take breaks fairly often.
